Smart Wardrobe Application

UX Research & Design • 2025

Designed an application to help users select outfits from their existing wardrobe based on weather, occasion, and personal preferences. Conducted need-finding studies, usability testing, and delivered a medium-to-high fidelity Figma prototype.

Key Features: AI-powered outfit suggestions, drag-and-drop customization, three digitization methods (photo capture, barcode scanning, web search), outfit saving functionality.

Credit Card Default Prediction Model

Machine Learning • 2025

Built an end-to-end ML pipeline to predict credit card defaults using a dataset of 30,000 examples. Performed feature engineering (creating PAY_RATIO metrics), handled class imbalance, and compared four models.

Results: Achieved ROC-AUC of 0.776 with XGBoost after hyperparameter tuning. Used permutation importance to identify payment history as the strongest predictor.

LingoLeap Word Game

Java • GUI Development • 2024

Developed a multiplayer word game in Java where 3+ players fill in categories (Color, City, Animal, Flower, Body Part, Food) based on randomly selected letters. Implemented full game logic, scoring system, save/load functionality, and event logging.

Technical Implementation: Built with Java Swing for GUI, implemented player management system, automatic scoring with bonus/penalty logic, and persistent data storage.
